0.original: Papawazu would offer you another commission and a chance to admire him, if the mood strikes you.

1.original: The shipment of processed ceruleum will finally resume, to the satisfaction of all parties─well, except the coblyns, but creatures of their sort have no say, and dead ones doubly so. Report the news to Syntgoht at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.

2.original: Syntgoht is relieved, though vexed by the price hike. Once the goods reach him in a few days, he should in turn be able to fill his orders.

24.original: Speak with Syntgoht at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.

48.original: <hex:021A020203>Any<hex:021A020103>way! The ceruleum must flow. No more delays in shipping─another brilliant coup by Papawazu! Oh, is that a feather? For my cap? Why, thank you very much!

49.original: Sooo, you can tell Syntgoht that his shipment will be there in just a few days. <hex:021A020203>Un<hex:021A020103>fortunately, there'll be a wee increase in price. Security surcharge, you know! Everybody does it.

50.original: Welcome, <hex:021A020203>welcome<hex:021A020103>! What might a discerning─oh, it's you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Talked to Papawazu? Really! He said a matter of days?

51.original: So, my dear <hex:02080EE905FF056C616479FF046D616E03>, you're telling me they're shipping what's owed me but charging more for it. I wish Amajina and <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> his sons the joy of my gil. I hope it gives them gout.

52.original: I do appreciate you sorting this out, and with that puttock Papawazu, no less. A discerning middleman such as myself will certainly remember you for future commissions!
